sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: Pros first: vitamin E is the standout identity. Almonds have a clearer vitamin E story than most nuts. Magnesium support adds real value. The mineral side helps justify the calorie density. Portable whole-food fat snack. They are easy to use without turning into a more processed snack.

sections.title: Cons
sections.narration: The drawbacks next: calorie density makes portions matter. Small handful changes can move the energy load quickly. Phytates and oxalates add a mineral caveat. The minerals are useful, but absorption is not perfectly straightforward. Tree-nut allergy limits use. For some people, almonds are simply not a usable option.
